close_reason: Fixed doc citation to accurately describe what §3.6.1 specifies vs. what the description field does
description: The doc comment says 'RFC 8620 §3.6.1 — unknownCapability with the failing URI in the description.' RFC 8620 §3.6.1 does not specify that the URI goes in the JMAP error description field — it shows the URI in the RFC 7807 HTTP 'detail' field. A contributor reading this comment will think the spec requires the URI in description, or that description and detail are equivalent concepts. Should clarify: this stores the URI in description so the HTTP response layer can forward it (same convention as JmapError::limit()).
title: doc comment on unknown_capability_with_detail: §3.6.1 citation is misleading
